text: If you've got outdoor plans today, front-load them, because the afternoon and tonight are turning into a real soaker. Expect a mostly cloudy start near 79, warming into the low 80s with the humidity sitting heavy. Showers and a few thunderstorms fire up between noon and 5, and while the official call keeps today's rain chance around 30%, the wetter models are much more convinced, and given the flash flood watch already out for slow-moving storms, I'd side with them. Tonight's the real deal, rain chances jump to 90% with a quarter to half inch possible, so plan indoor evening activities. The lake's under a wind advisory too, south winds 15 to 25 knots with 2 to 3 foot waves, not a place to be this afternoon. Monday brings more of the same with showers likely through the day and another half inch possible before things finally dry out. My call: get outside before midday if you want dry time, be off the water well before then, and save the bigger plans for Tuesday's sunshine.
